thread:
people-ops: Quick update  Handbook patch v2.5 deployed. Key changes: clarified PTO carryover rules, added a short mandatory Ethics & Data Handling ack, and updated international office stipend guidance. Mandatory ack applies to all employees and contractors with any access to customer data. Deadline: 2026-07-20. Estimated time: 10-15 minutes.

Links:
 Handbook v2.5: https://handbook.redwood.ai/v2.5
 Ack module: https://learning.redwood.ai/courses/ethics-data-ack-2026
 Manager tracker: https://sheets.redwood.ai/people-ops/handbook-v2-5-tracker

people-ops: Managers please confirm completion in the tracker by the deadline. For contractors: auto-enroll if they have prod/customer-data keys or support access. If contractor is staging-only, request exemption in the tracker with the role scope.

ethan: Quick Q  does PTO carryover change affect part-time folks who shift between PT and FT within a fiscal year?

people-ops: Good question. Short answer: accrual follows employment type per pay period; if status changed mid-year we pro-rate carryover using the pay-period-weighted formula. See the appendix example in the PTO section. If you want a calculator sheet ping us.

priya: For interns who are on 3-month contracts, do we need them to do the ack? They never touch prod.

people-ops: Interns with zero prod/customer-data access are not required. Add them to the tracker as "non-prod" and request exemption. If they have any access to tickets or PII in tools, they must complete.

hrbot: Reminder scheduled  "Handbook v2.5 ack due" 2026-07-13 09:00 PDT. :bell:

tana: Vendor question: our translation vendor occasionally sees customer copy for QA in a redacted flow. Are they auto-enrolled?

people-ops: If the vendor accesses unredacted customer data, auto-enroll. If strictly redacted copies, request exemption with the vendor scope notes and a contract clause reference. Contracts/legal will triage.

martin: Finance needs a CSV export grouped by manager and employment_type for audit sampling. Can we get that on 2026-07-22?

people-ops: We'll publish a manager export on 2026-07-21. If you need a custom filter earlier, DM the filter spec (manager list + employment_type) and we'll pull it.

denA: I marked a contractor as completed after an in-person training. Is an uploaded attendance sheet sufficient?

people-ops: Yes  managers can mark completions with attached evidence (attendance sheet or certificate). We'll run a 10% audit sample. Use the "evidence_url" column.

ethan: One more thing  will this ack show up in performance review dashboards as a compliance flag?

people-ops: Yes. Completion will be visible as a compliance attribute in the perf dashboard and included in calibration exports. Noncompliance will trigger manager outreach; repeated noncompliance escalates to HR.

priya: Thanks. Also, can managers bulk-export their team's completion CSV? I want to attach to calibration packets.

people-ops: Managers can download team exports from the tracker UI. We'll also push a master CSV to owners on 2026-07-21. If your team needs a custom layout, DM the spec.

martin: How long are we retaining these ack records? Accounting asked for retention policy reference for audits.

people-ops: Retention is 7 years per policy. Records live in /compliance/records. For extracts contact compliance@redwood.ai.

people-ops: We'll post a short FAQ and a manager checklist in this channel tomorrow. If anyone runs into permissions issues with the tracker or training link, open a #help ticket. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
